decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves maximizing damage output through efficient spells and creatures like Vivi Ornitier, Marauding Mako, and Tersa Lightshatter. The deck also includes card advantage options with Proft's Eidetic Memory and Fear of Missing Out. With a mix of burn spells like Abrade and Torch the Tower, along with versatile creatures and support cards, this deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing a combination of red and blue cards for maximum efficiency. Cards like Fear of Missing Out and Marauding Mako help deal damage quickly, while Proft's Eidetic Memory and Vivi Ornitier provide card advantage and control options. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Glacial Dragonhunt and Thundering Falls to secure victory. By constantly applying pressure and controlling the board, this UR Aggro deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to control the board early game with cheap removal spells like Shoot the Sheriff and Phantom Interference, then ramp up the aggression with powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Cecil, Dark Knight. Utilizing a mix of evasion creatures like Spyglass Siren and Deep-Cavern Bat, along with disruptive elements like Enduring Curiosity and Tragic Trajectory, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent while keeping them on the back foot. The deck's mana base is designed for both consistency and flexibility in casting its spells.

The main concept of this Esper Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. By efficiently managing resources and controlling the board with cards like Spyglass Siren and Stock Up, while also utilizing strong attackers like Sunpearl Kirin and Cosmogrand Zenith, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and finish the game quickly. The deck also includes strategic land choices to ensure smooth mana curve and support the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The deck includes efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Screaming Nemesis, along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Helix for direct damage. Cheeky House-Mouse provides additional creature support, while Boros Charm offers versatility in protection and additional damage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and Mountains for consistent and fast mana production.

This deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to apply early pressure and control the board. By efficiently deploying creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Preacher of the Schism, along with spells like Shoot the Sheriff and Phantom Interference, the goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to secure victory by maintaining control of the battlefield and outpacing the opponent's resources.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and pump spells in order to deal damage as quickly as possible. The key strategy is to build a board presence early on, using cards like Llanowar Elves and Floodpits Drowner to ramp up mana and play larger threats like Genemorph Imago. Snakeskin Veil and Sentinel of the Nameless City provide protection for your creatures, while Into the Flood Maw and Spyglass Siren disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck aims to finish the game before the opponent can establish a solid defense.

This deck focuses on using aggressive spells and creatures to deal fast damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Opt, Torch the Tower, and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Cards like Ral, Crackling Wit and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide additional utility and damage potential. The mana base is set up to ensure a steady stream of blue and red mana for casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and secure a win before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, board wipes, and card draw. The deck aims to establish a stable board presence while maintaining card advantage and thwarting the opponent's threats. By utilizing cards like Split Up, Day of Judgment, and No More Lies, the deck aims to control the game tempo and ultimately outvalue the opponent to secure victory. Additionally, cards like Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Ultima provide additional win conditions to close out the game when necessary.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures quickly, utilizing mana ramp from Llanowar Elves and Herd Heirloom to get ahead early. The Brightglass Gearhulk provides a strong threat, while Dusk Rose Reliquary and Tough Cookie offer protection and versatility. Sentinel of the Nameless City and Warden of the Inner Sky help maintain pressure on the opponent. Hushwood Verge and Starting Town provide additional mana fixing. Seam Rip and Hardlight Containment disrupt opponent's strategies, while Dyadrine, Synthesis Amalgam offers a powerful late-game threat. Marketback Walker and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain offer additional value and card advantage.
